member.name: T:AStarDev.Localization.LocalizationService
member.summary:
Loads localised strings from embedded JSON resources named Assets/Localization/{culture}.json (e.g. en-GB.json) in the supplied resource assembly.
Resource file format:
{ "locale": "en-GB", "App.Title": "OneDrive Sync", ... }
Adding a new language: 1. Copy en-GB.json to fr-FR.json and translate values. 2. Mark the new file as EmbeddedResource in the .csproj. 3. The service discovers it automatically at startup.
